1.name: Expanding Borders
1.text: {asterisk}You want 75 or more cards in your kingdom (not counting permanent cards). This is worth -2{fame} for each card missing from 75.
1.helpText:
VERSION NOTE: This card now requires 75 cards instead of 70 in previous prints.
Example: If you have 7 permanent cards and 60 cards in your deck, you are missing 15 cards, since you want 75 cards in your deck. This card would then be worth -30 fame [vp].
NOTE: Goals have the yellow name banner, just like persons. However, this is NOT a person.

4.name: Maximizer
4.text: {asterisk}Worth -1{fame} per card with exactly 0{fame} (excluding permanent cards).
4.helpText:
This doesn't count cards with negative fame [vp], only cards with exactly zero [vp].
NOTE: Goals have the yellow name banner, just like persons. However, this is NOT a person.

description:
VERSION NOTE: Expanding Borders now requires 75 fame instead of 70 in previous versions.
This is a goal card which gives fame [vp] depending on how well you do. The red arrows at the top of this card means that when you discover it, you must choose which of its 2 sides should be face up (the serial number must be at the top of this card, whichever side you choose). Choose wisely, since you cannot change this later.
